title: Careful What You Wish For / Grim Ailment
problem: "Only last 1 turn" not found in these builders (not traced).
notes: Fix: ? User 2026-10-26: add the explicit '... only last for 1 turn' limit (not found in code): buffs / debuffs gained by the holder side's creatures get duration 1. Integrate with SU-0080's hook at the 3 bc_ExecuteEvents scr_CritAddCondition sites (they own that call) or the event builders. | 2026-10-26 hook batch F1 built (research/hooks_F1.json, loader/hooks_F1.c). hook_su0080_add_condition (the 3 buff/debuff event sites in bc_ExecuteEvents) passes the arguments through f1_su0064_args via the SU-0064 slot: a buff gained by a creature whose side holds Careful What You Wish For (1071), or a debuff from a source whose side holds Grim Ailment (1072), gets duration 1; permanent (-2) conditions are left alone. Needs SU-0080 (owns the call sites). Coverage: conditions added outside those event sites (direct scr_CritAddCondition calls) are not limited. In-game test: Careful What You Wish For on your side: a buff cast on your creature lasts 1 turn. Grim Ailment on your side: debuffs your creatures inflict last 1 turn.

release_notes.effect: Careful What You Wish For and Grim Ailment (traits)
release_notes.intended: Extra random buffs (or debuffs), but the side's buffs (or the debuffs it applies) only last 1 turn.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, the 1-turn limit was missing.
release_notes.fix: Now those buffs and debuffs last 1 turn; permanent ones are left alone. Partial: conditions added directly rather than through a normal buff or debuff (some trait and start-of-battle effects) keep their normal duration. Requires SU-0080.
